notes.title: Game is still work in progress!
notes.notes:
Heyo everyone! Just wanted to let you all know that the game is still being developed, the project had to be put on hold due to constant work BUT the game is still going to be done. 

I will be doing this project adjacent to another on youtube, so I can say safely that this project is far from being finished. Still lots of research and development to do though!

Thanks for the support, I do see the wishlists going up which is something of a great motivation :D
